entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Before we begin in earnest, we mus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we begin in earnest, we must acknowledge the results of the recent House of Delegates election."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He had a dour look on his face."
entries.dialogueText: He had a dour look on his face.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In a historic first for our kingdo..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a historic first for our kingdom, the Rizian People's Party won the majority of seats."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo had a wide smile on his face."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo had a wide smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Rizian National Coalition had..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian National Coalition had an excellent showing. They now make up over three-quarters of delegates."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo smiled confidently."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo smiled confidently.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As usual, the Rizian National Coal..."
entries.dialogueText: "As usual, the Rizian National Coalition secured the majority of seats. No significant gains were made, but no losses, either."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""By unanimous vote, Manus Sazon was..."
entries.dialogueText: "By unanimous vote, Manus Sazon was named House Speaker."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina made no effort to hide her joy..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina made no effort to hide her joy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina struggled to maintain a neutra..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina struggled to maintain a neutral expression.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina made no effort to hide her dis..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina made no effort to hide her dismay.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? How could this happen?""
entries.dialogueText: "What? How could this happen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This shows that the public is hung..."
entries.dialogueText: "This shows that the public is hungry for a change in our kingdom's direction. We should listen to what they have to say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who cares about the election? I ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who cares about the election? I make the laws in this country, not the Delegates."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Brilliant. I'm glad to hear that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brilliant. I'm glad to hear that the majority of the Rizian public still respects the authority of their monarch and his supporters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who cares about the election? I ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who cares about the election? I make the laws in this country, not the Delegates."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Should we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Should we?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression turned quizzical."
entries.dialogueText: His expression turned quizzical.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You know as well as I.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know as well as I."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression darkened."
entries.dialogueText: His expression darkened.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I wouldn't be surprised if House S..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be surprised if House Sazon had a hand in manipulating the voting results."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And I am not certain the votes of..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am not certain the votes of the foreigners who flocked to the polls should even be counted as legitimate."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""With some aid from the so-called f..."
entries.dialogueText: "With some aid from the so-called free press, of course."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You are right, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are right, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But you must consider that they we..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you must consider that they weren't elected out of nowhere."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You are right, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are right, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But the continued dominance of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the continued dominance of the RNC is proof that you should stay the course."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The RNC? You're sure they won?""
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC? You're sure they won?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Quite sure, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Quite sure, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression turned quizzical."
entries.dialogueText: His expression turned quizzical.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And the hordes of foreigners sudde..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the hordes of foreigners suddenly clamoring to have their votes counted."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In spite of the lies told by the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "In spite of the lies told by the so-called free press..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Despite the hordes of foreigners s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the hordes of foreigners suddenly clamoring to have their votes counted."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unfortunately, today's meeting is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, today's meeting is not all good news."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In other news...""
entries.dialogueText: "In other news..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That isn't the only unpleasant new..."
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't the only unpleasant news I have to share today."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But moving on to other news...""
entries.dialogueText: "But moving on to other news..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""By unanimous vote, Daria de Rava h..."
entries.dialogueText: "By unanimous vote, Daria de Rava has retained the position of House Speaker."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say what you will about Mr. Sazon,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say what you will about Mr. Sazon, but he has earned that seat."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Has he?""
entries.dialogueText: "Has he?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thanks to the reform of our electo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the reform of our electoral system, hundreds of experienced politicians lost their provincial council seats."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Whether in the House of Delegates..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether in the House of Delegates or across the country, we now have a glut of newcomers, all of whom believe the country needs sweeping change without having the faintest clue how to accomplish it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give the new Delegates a chance, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give the new Delegates a chance, Your Grace. Their ideas could invigorate all of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Delegates are still far away f..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Delegates are still far away from the levers of power. They can't actually do anything."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No. Not for now.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Not for now."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If they don't destroy it first.""
entries.dialogueText: "If they don't destroy it first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look on the bright side. We finall..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look on the bright side. We finally have a parliament that represents the people of this nation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed. Down to the last village i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. Down to the last village idiot."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I admit I questioned your reform o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit I questioned your reform of the Rizian electoral system at first. But we now know for a fact that the people of this kingdom favor stability and tradition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for the update.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the update."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be so negative, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so negative, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, I'm pleased with the outcome.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I'm pleased with the outcome."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? Is that true?""
entries.dialogueText: "What? Is that true?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about the voter demographics?..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the voter demographics? I want to know who voted for what."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about the voter demographics?..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the voter demographics? I want to know who voted for what."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Certainly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He started reading the documents in..."
entries.dialogueText: He started reading the documents in front of him.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Due to the inclusion of millions o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the inclusion of millions of new voters from foreign origin, as well as the electoral reform which took the reserved seats for the nobles..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""...The nobility had only an influe..."
entries.dialogueText: "...The nobility had only an influence of around ten percent on the overall election results."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Despite the inclusion of millions..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the inclusion of millions of new voters from foreign origin, as well as the electoral reform which took the reserved seats for the nobles..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""...The nobility is firmly supporti..."
entries.dialogueText: "...The nobility is firmly supporting the RNC, and thus, the Crown."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Despite the electoral reform which..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the electoral reform which took the reserved seats for the nobles..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The nobility, of course, is firmly..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobility, of course, is firmly supporting the RNC, and thus, the Crown."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Due to the electoral reform which..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the electoral reform which took the reserved seats for the nobles..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""...The nobility's influence on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "...The nobility's influence on the election results were more than halved in this election."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Due to the inclusion of millions o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the inclusion of millions of new voters from foreign origin..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""However, there are rumors of certa..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, there are rumors of certain members of the nobility to be supporting the opposition."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He had a chastising look on his fac..."
entries.dialogueText: He had a chastising look on his face.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We're doing reasonably well among..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're doing reasonably well among the middle class. About two-thirds of them are supporting the RNC."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The middle class appears divided i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The middle class appears divided in their support, almost exactly in half."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We're doing better than ever with..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're doing better than ever with the middle class. We have an overwhelming majority of them behind the RNC."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We've fallen out of favor with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've fallen out of favor with the middle class. About two-thirds of them are now supporting the RPP."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our support among the middle class..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our support among the middle class has plummeted. Only the upper middle class, which makes up a mere quarter are supporting the RNC."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""To be frank, we have lost almost a..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be frank, we have lost almost all of our support from the middle class. They have given their support to the RPP."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Interestingly, the support of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interestingly, the support of the lower class also appears to be divided in half."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""However, the lower class citizens..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the lower class citizens appear divided in their support, almost exactly in half."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Fortunately, the RNC's popularity..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, the RNC's popularity among our lower class citizens has gone through the roof. We seem to have gained almost all of their votes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Fortunately, the RNC's popularity..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, the RNC's popularity among our lower class citizens has gone through the roof. We seem to have gained a sizeable number of votes away from the RPP."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unfortunately, the RNC's popularit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the RNC's popularity among our lower class citizens remain very low. Most of them have given their support to the RPP."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unfortunately, we have next to no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we have next to no support from our lower class citizens. They have given their support to the RPP."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course, it wasn't enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, it wasn't enough."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Despite this fact, it wasn't enoug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite this fact, it wasn't enough to influence the outcome."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And there are millions of foreigne..."
entries.dialogueText: "And there are millions of foreigners who were also allowed to vote in this election..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Surprisingly, around half of them..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surprisingly, around half of them have voted for the RNC."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Surprisingly, an overwhelming majo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surprisingly, an overwhelming majority of these people have given their support to the RNC."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Surprisingly, a slight majority of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surprisingly, a slight majority of these people have given their support to the RNC."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unsurprisingly, all of them gave t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unsurprisingly, all of them gave their support to the opposition."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unfortunately, today's meeting is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, today's meeting is not all good news."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""All in all, I don't see anything t..."
entries.dialogueText: "All in all, I don't see anything that should concern us at this moment regarding the House of Delegates. The RNC holds the power."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""All in all, this election should m..."
entries.dialogueText: "All in all, this election should make us concerned about the current climate within the House of Delegates. The RPP has now become a real threat."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""However, that isn't the only unple..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, that isn't the only unpleasant news I have to share today."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But moving on to other news...""
entries.dialogueText: "But moving on to other news..."
